objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperless artifact created, edited, released, distributed, archived, revised, translated, invalidated or reactivated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Document name composed by default from abbreviation, number per type and title.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document type abbreviation included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client, consecutive, 4-digit number for each document type included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title included in the document name.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Document version retained, created, released, revised, invalidated or reactivated.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Workflow or lifecycle state of the document, such as editing, released, valid, archived or out of force.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document by TAG technology.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released document validity count starts.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate the valid-until date.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date resulting from valid from and period of extended validity.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader authorizations via user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute for the registered author of the document.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute for additional persons with change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute for reviewers assigned to the document.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute for releasers assigned to the document.

attributes.name: releaser_incl._translation
attributes.description: Attribute for releasers including translation.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects e-mail notification for the next released version.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects distribution of acknowledgement workflow tasks for the next released version.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating a document and used for templates, numbering, extended validity and archive duration.

attributes.name: type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation for a document type.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for which a check of extended validity is necessary; standard is 3 years.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for archiving documents of the type; standard is 10 years.

objs.name: document_level
objs.description: Level in the document pyramid used to differentiate policies, guidelines, procedural instructions and work instructions.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type describing locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting special work steps and detailed steps usually relevant for a few departments.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for each document type and selectable when creating new objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or new documents generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File or document uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized or customer-specific descriptive data maintained for a document.

objs.name: category
objs.description: Grouping of document attributes and metadata according to their purpose.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document automatically released with the main document and subject to its own versioning.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created and managed for a document without affecting its content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person involved as reader, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, initiator or workflow participant.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used for authorizations, reader access, role assignment, distribution and archive access.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read or change right assigned at group or person level for documents and dependent objects.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: Defined group used to assign read and change rights to users or persons for each document.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported processing sequence used for release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement and translation approval.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants and completed during workflow-supported processing.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants and documented in the system for each released version.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent by the system to inform users about workflow tasks, status, release, change proposals, validity extension and acknowledgement.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document 30 days before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a released document that has no additional validity.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to re-validate invalidated documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document assigning user groups or persons for release information or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Workflow-supported confirmation without signature requested from persons or users on the distribution list.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific view listing documents relevant to users based on distribution groups.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report or search for documents, instructions and acknowledgements.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which a document can be specified as visible or not.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Object that documents can be automatically linked with.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Object that documents can be automatically linked with.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Object that documents can be automatically linked with.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Object such as IT applications with which documents can be linked.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Master data referenced in document properties.

objs.name: company
objs.description: Relevant company maintained via document properties for linking documents.

objs.name: area_of_validity
objs.description: Area maintained via document properties for linking documents.

objs.name: reference
objs.description: Reference maintained via document properties to link documents to master data or other documents.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Language-dependent version of released document content checked and released with workflow support.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attachment of a new information object.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: Select the corresponding document type when creating a new document.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select a document template when creating a new object.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: edit_document_property
evts.description: Maintain document properties, attributes and metadata.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit the content of a document with the implemented editing client.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document after content editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_document_as_pdf
evts.description: Display the current converted version on the web as PDF.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations in the control category.

evts.name: assign_release_participant
evts.description: Assign participants in the release process via property editing.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add additional information to a document by attachment of a new information object.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Publish additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly due to lack of criticality.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add an attachment to a document by attachment of a new information object.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment for archiving and archive it with release of the next main document version.

evts.name: start_approval_process
evts.description: Initiate the approval process after document creation, attribute and content maintenance and document control definition.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs the creator workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks the content of a document according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser completes the release task positively and releases the document.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: Reviewer or releaser rejects during review or release.

evts.name: cancel_workflow
evts.description: Cancel workflow for subsequent participants after a rejection.

evts.name: send_e_mail_notification
evts.description: Inform users involved of workflow status, tasks, release, proposals or acknowledgements by e-mail.

evts.name: document_electronic_signature
evts.description: Document signatures of participants in the system for each released version.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish a released document so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_document_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new editing version when a valid released document is revised or version-triggering changes occur.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid and released document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents editing of assigned change proposals directly in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity so the request is deleted and the document remains valid.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process when a revised version is released or override is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: Create a request for override for a document with no additional validity.

evts.name: start_override_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start workflow for processing the request for override after its attachment.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare a document out of force, archive it and revoke rights except the archive group.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Delete existing edited versions after declaration of out of force.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation in the folder provided and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start workflow for the request for reactivation.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Confirm reactivation, creating a new document version and restoring authorizations and attachments.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain distribution lists for each document by assigning user groups or persons.

evts.name: distribute_by_e_mail
evts.description: Inform assigned users and users of assigned user groups by e-mail notification when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request persons and users on the distribution list to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient actively confirms acknowledgement in a workflow-supported process without signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content of the system into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Check and release the translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client for a local addition and reference the original document.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: Create or maintain a reference to the original document or other objects.

o2o.description: A document has a corresponding document type selected when it is created.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
A document can be created from a selected template.
External files or documents can be uploaded to an object cover for a document.
External files or documents can be uploaded to an object cover.
Document properties include standardized and customer-specific metadata.
Attributes and metadata are grouped into categories.
Additional information can be added to each document and is associated with the main document.
Attachments are associated with a main document and released with it.
A change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
Users can be assigned to a document as readers, authors, co-authors, reviewers, releasers or translators.
User groups can be assigned to a document for reader authorizations and distribution.
Authorizations are assigned specifically to documents.
Authorization groups are defined in the system to assign read and change rights.
Users are assigned to user groups.
Authorizations for readers are assigned via user group assignment.
Personal authorizations are assigned for author, co-author, reviewer and releaser attributes.
Workflow-supported processing assigns tasks to workflow participants.
Users involved in a workflow receive and complete workflow tasks.
Workflow participants complete tasks with an electronic signature.
Signatures are documented in the system for each released version of a document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for override is created for a selected document.
A request for reactivation selects the corresponding document for reactivation.
Distribution lists can be maintained for each document.
Distribution is maintained by assigning user groups.
Distribution is maintained by assigning persons.
Acknowledgement is requested and confirmed for a document version.
Dashboards list documents relevant to the user.
Reports evaluate documents stored in the system.
Documents can be automatically linked with processes.
Documents can be automatically linked with organizational units.
Documents can be automatically linked with risks.
Documents can be automatically linked with master data.
IT applications are given as an example of master data.
IT applications can be maintained in document properties for linking.
Relevant companies can be maintained in document properties.
Areas of validity can be maintained in document properties.
References can be maintained via document properties to link documents to master data or other documents.
Documents can reference or be linked with other documents.
Released documents can have language-dependent versions.
A document can be specified as visible or not in clients.
Attachments have an effect on the associated version of the main document.
Attachments pass through all statuses of the release process of the main document.
Policy is listed as level 1 in the document pyramid.
Guideline is listed as level 2 in the document pyramid.
Procedural instruction is listed as level 3 in the document pyramid.
Work instruction is listed as level 4 in the document pyramid.
